**Job Description**



I\&O Platform Infrastructure Application Performance Management and Logging (ELK) SME



Assistant Director \| Enterprise Technology

  


**The opportunity**



In a plan to strengthen and extend our footprint in EY Enterprise Technology, we are looking for a proven Application Performance Management (APM) and Logging SME to support and evolve EY's monitoring and observability platforms globally. The role will provide engineering leadership, operational support, automation and lifecycle management for the firm's APM tooling and the ELK (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana) stack. The successful candidate will work with cutting\-edge observability technologies, driving platform maturity, operational excellence and engineering innovation across EY's global infrastructure estate.

  


**Your key responsibilities**



The I\&O Platform Infrastructure APM and Logging SME provides technical leadership and engineering of complex nature for the firm's application performance monitoring and centralized logging platforms. This professional applies knowledge of APM solutions, the ELK stack, log management, metrics pipelines and distributed tracing to support enterprise\-scale workloads and enable rapid incident response.

  



The role requires deep knowledge of the firm's infrastructure monitoring landscape to implement platform enhancements, lifecycle management activities, onboarding programs, security initiatives and operational improvements. The SME will serve as the subject matter authority for APM and logging platforms, partnering with application teams, infrastructure engineers and security stakeholders across global locations to ensure observability coverage, data quality and platform reliability.

  


**Skills and attributes for success**


* Strong experience designing, deploying and administering ELK stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana) at enterprise scale.
* Deep knowledge of APM tooling (e.g., Dynatrace, AppDynamics, Elastic APM, New Relic or equivalent).
* Experience architecting centralized logging solutions and log aggregation pipelines.
* Strong understanding of metrics, traces and logs as the three pillars of observability.

* Knowledge of Logstash pipeline development and Beats (Filebeat, Metricbeat, Winlogbeat) deployment.
* Experience building Kibana dashboards, visualizations and alerting rules.
* Experience with log parsing, field extraction, grok patterns and data enrichment.

description:

**Job description**
-------------------


Requisition ID: 1744229
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  



EndPoint Infrastructure Patching \& Vulnerability Management Administrator


**Role Title**


EndPoint Infrastructure Patching \& Vulnerability Management Administrator

  

**Function / Portfolio**

Digital Workplace Enablement Services (DWES) – EndPoint Management

  

**Scope**



Patching \& vulnerability remediation of the \~450 on\-prem SCCM/APPPROXY infrastructure servers (CAS, Primary Sites, SQL site databases and supporting server roles)

  



**Job Description Summary**



Maintain and secure the Endpoint Management infrastructure (approximately 450 SCCM and AppProxy servers) by ensuring systems remain patched, hardened, and free of known vulnerabilities. Own the end\-to\-end server patching and remediation lifecycle, including monitoring, validation, deployment coordination, post\-patch verification, and driving vulnerability findings to closure.



The successful candidate will operate the patching lifecycle end to end: monitoring for released fixes, validating them, sequencing and executing patching in coordination with the SCCM and Approxy engineering team, restarting/validating servers, and driving vulnerability findings to closure.



The estate is split across non\-production and production environments and includes the Central Administration Site (CAS), Primary Sites and their SQL site databases, which are the true single point of failure for a site. Work is executed against an accelerated cadence and, when required, under an Emergency/Zero\-Day change model. The role is hands\-on, evidence\-driven and governed by EY change management (RFC / eCAB).

  

**Key Responsibilities**



**Server Patching \& Maintenance**


* Execute monthly, accelerated and emergency patching across the \~450 SCCM/AppProxy servers (non\-production first, then production), following the confirmed environment sequence.
* Sequence patching correctly so Windows/SQL work completes before SCCM/APPPROXY patching in each environment; perform and validate server restarts within the agreed windows.
* Apply Microsoft SCCM/APPPROXY hotfixes and SQL Server cumulative updates (CU/GDR) as prerequisites for a healthy SCCM/APPPROXY platform, coordinating carefully around SQL site databases to avoid taking a whole site down.
* Support High\-Availability failover patching (patch passive node/SQL replica, switch active/passive, patch former active) to minimize outage windows.

  


**Vulnerability Management \& Remediation**


* Own the remediation of vulnerabilities flagged against the SCCM/APPPROXY server estate (e.g. GVM / scanner findings from tools such as Qualys / Tenable), tracking each item to closure within SLA.
* Triage and prioritize findings by criticality (CVSS), separating in\-scope SCCM/APPPROXY/SQL items from those owned by other teams and re\-assigning out\-of\-scope items correctly (accurate CMDB ownership).
* Validate that deployed fixes actually mitigate the reported vulnerability, remove flagged/unnecessary software, and capture evidence for audit and closure.
* Maintain and report remediation status, backlog reduction and platform health metrics to the SCCM/APPPROXY lead and stakeholders.

  


**Coordination, Change \& War Room Operations**


* Liaise daily with the core SCCM/APPPROXY engineering team, SQL/DBA, platform, and service management to plan and execute patch windows.
* Raise and manage changes through EY change management (RFC / eCAB), including emergency/zero\-day changes, respecting change freezes and approvals.
* Provide War Room coverage during patch surges and zero\-day events: readiness checks, live execution, validation, rollback if thresholds are exceeded, and clear stakeholder communication.
* Produce concise, evidence\-based status updates and closure reports for leadership.

  


**Required Skills \& Experience**


* Hands\-on experience administering and patching SCCM/APPPROXY server infrastructure (CAS, Primary Sites, site system roles) in a large enterprise estate.
* Strong Windows Server administration skills (multi\-domain Active Directory) including patching, restart sequencing and post\-patch validation.
* Working knowledge of SQL Server as an SCCM/APPPROXY prerequisite — applying CU/GDR updates and understanding site\-database criticality and Always On / HA concepts.
* Solid understanding of enterprise change management (RFC / CAB / eCAB) and evidence/audit discipline.
* Ability to work under pressure in a War Room / on\-call model across accelerated and emergency patch cycles.

  


**Out of Scope**



To keep the role focused, the following are explicitly not the primary responsibility of this position:


* Day\-to\-day administration of the SCCM/APPPROXY application layer — application packaging/deployment, collections/targeting, task sequences, client health and end\-user device compliance.
* Operating\-system patching governance owned by other platform teams (the role executes/sequences server patching but does not own OS patch policy).

  


**EY \| Building a better working world**

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

  

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

title: Part Time Tutor in Environmental Sciences
description:
**Part\-Time Tutor – Environmental Sciences**

**Location:** Kochi, Kerala  
**Employment Type:** Part\-Time  
**Institution:** Wellcaza School of Health Sciences (under Wellcaza Hospital Pvt Limited)

Job Summary

Wellcaza School of Health Sciences is looking for a passionate, academically qualified and knowledgeable **Part\-Time Tutor in Environmental Sciences** to support the academic development of students through engaging, structured and student\-centred teaching.

The tutor will be responsible for delivering lectures, facilitating academic discussions, supporting assignments and helping students understand the relationship between environmental factors, public health, sanitation and healthcare for BSc Allied Health Scinces programme.

Eligibility \& Academic Qualifications

Candidates **must meet the following academic requirements**:

* **Master's Degree in Environmental Sciences / Environmental Studies / Environmental Management**, **OR**
* **Postgraduate Degree in Life Sciences, Chemical Sciences or Physical Sciences**, **along with an M.Phil. in Environmental Sciences**.
* The required qualification(s) must be obtained through **Regular, Full\-Time mode** from a **UGC\-recognised/approved university or institution**.

Important Eligibility Note

**Candidates who have obtained their qualifying degree(s) through Online / Distance Education mode will not be considered for this position.**

**Candidates whose qualifying degrees are awarded by foreign universities/institutions whos QS ranking is above 250 globally are also not eligible for this position.**

**Candidates who do not meet the above academic eligibility criteria are requested not to apply.**

Key Responsibilities

* Deliver engaging and structured classes in **Environmental Sciences / Environmental Management**.
* Explain fundamental concepts related to environment, ecology, pollution, environmental health and sustainability.
* Cover topics such as **air pollution, water pollution, waste management, biomedical waste, pesticides, heavy metals and environmental monitoring**, as relevant to the curriculum.

What We Offer

* Part\-time teaching opportunity within a healthcare education institution.
* Opportunity to engage with students pursuing healthcare and allied\-health programmes.
* Professional and collaborative academic environment.
* Opportunity to contribute to practical and industry\-oriented learning.

How to Apply

Interested and eligible candidates may apply with their **updated CV**, clearly mentioning their **academic qualifications, university, mode of study (Regular/Full\-Time), teaching experience and subject expertise** send updated resume with LinkedIn profile to Institute@wellcaza.com or directly walk in on interview on 21st September 2026 at HRD Office, First Floor WELLCAZA SCHOOL OF HEALTH SCIENCES

Edappally Raghavan Pillai Road, Elamakkara, Kochi, Ernakulam, Ernakulam District, Kerala 682026, India. For location contact HR Assistant Biya 80899 20900

**Only candidates meeting the prescribed academic eligibility criteria will be considered.**

Pay: ₹300\.00 \- ₹500\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 4\.0 per week

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: In person
